plan.notes: Source: Berkeley College official 2025-2026 Undergraduate Catalog, 'Sample Course Sequence' page for the Bachelor of Business Administration Degree (BBA), Business Administration - Management (berkeleycollege.edu/catalogs/undergraduate-2025-2026/). Eight semesters transcribed exactly as published: 15 credits each, 120 total, matching the published '120 SEMESTER CREDITS REQUIRED FOR GRADUATION'. Prerequisite ordering verified: ACC1111 Financial Accounting I (Sem 2) before FIN3302 Corporate Finance (Sem 5). Published program rules: Business Electives must be selected from the Larry L. Luing School of Business courses; 3000/4000-level requirement on the double-starred Business Electives; 12 credits of Liberal Arts Electives must be at the 3000/4000 level; 6 credits of Management Electives must be at the 3000/4000 level. Semester 5 'Free Elective, 6' transcribed as two 3-credit Free Elective slots. Berkeley College is a for-profit institution with its New York City campus in Manhattan; programs may also be completed at other campuses or online per the catalog note.
